column1: Net profit fell 30 % in the third quarter .
The company will hold its annual general meeting on Tuesday .
Sales rose sharply thanks to strong demand in Asia .
The company reported a loss of EUR 0.4 mn compared to a loss of EUR 1.9 mn a year earlier .
Russia will cancel import restrictions on Finnish dairy products .
Operating costs increased by 15 % due to higher energy prices .
Shares plummeted after the CEO resigned .
The board has no plans to cut jobs this year .
